intro: Dot was lovely while it lasted: a companion on your iPhone that remembered your chats. Then October 2025 arrived and it was gone. That is the risk of a closed app with one owner. GAIA keeps the part people loved, memory that builds over time, and removes the risk. It is source-available, so it cannot be shut down on you, and it puts memory to work across your email, calendar, and tasks instead of just reminiscing.
